title: Director, Bloomberg Center for Cities at Harvard University Emma Bloomberg Senior Lecturer in Public Policy and Management
affiliation: Director, Bloomberg Center for Cities at Harvard University Emma Bloomberg Senior Lecturer in Public Policy and Management
bio: Jorrit de Jong is director of the Bloomberg Center for Cities at Harvard University and the Emma Bloomberg Senior Lecturer in Public Policy and Management at Harvard Kennedy School. His research, teaching, and engagement with practice focus on the challenges of making the public sector more effective, efficient, equitable, and responsive to social needs.
